summary: Stage 3 production authentication, task completion review and atomic XP/Coin/Money reward flow passed isolated H2 and full PostgreSQL 16.15 API gates.

environment.containerLifecycle: temporary localhost-only container; stopped and removed after the gate

commands.result: Initial compile stopped on a Java record accessor/static helper name shadow; the helper call was qualified before retry.
Legacy anonymous Stage 2 API tests received the expected new fail-closed 401 and were replaced with authenticated Stage 3 scenarios.
First authenticated flow exposed deferred JPA flush before JDBC foreign-key writes; explicit parent/child saveAndFlush fixed the transaction ordering.
H2 PostgreSQL-mode isolation gate passed: 6 domain tests and 4 executed boot tests passed; the PostgreSQL-only schema test was skipped by environment condition.

commands.command: start temporary PostgreSQL 16 container; set test datasource environment; .\mvnw.cmd -pl family-growth-boot -am test; stop container
commands.result: Full API suite and schema validation ran on PostgreSQL 16.15. Six domain tests plus five boot tests passed with zero failures/errors/skips; Flyway V1/V2 and 13 required tables validated.

acceptance.AC3-01: PASS - BCrypt cost 12 hashes are stored instead of PIN values; opaque session tokens are stored only as 64-character SHA-256 hashes; five failed attempts lock login for 15 minutes.
acceptance.AC3-02: PASS - child submission is restricted to the authenticated child and joined family/plan/task ownership; cross-family access returns 404.
acceptance.AC3-03: PASS - approved completion atomically updates XP, Coin and Money and creates exactly two Money/Coin ledger records for the test vector; replay does not duplicate completion or rewards.
acceptance.AC3-04: PASS - automated negative cases cover missing token 401, CHILD review 403, cross-family 404, repeated review 409 and validation 400.
acceptance.AC3-05: PASS - PostgreSQL 16.15 ran the complete API scenario, Flyway migrations, Hibernate validation and table assertions.
